prep.summary:
Billing and ledger work is in good shape. Explicit invoice helper types are complete, including line items, totals, discounts, and generator materialization. Ledger posting uses `Decimal`, `Account`, and timezone-aware UTC timestamps. Targeted billing tests passed (34), a focused mypy check found no issues in the modified billing modules, and broader runs reported 96 passing tests; the main repository baseline had 318 passed and 4 skipped.

An invoice-total test for credit applied after a refund initially returned `90.00` instead of the expected `87.50`. Inspection suggested the credit/refund calculation order may be the cause, but no fix was made in this excerpt. The operator considered the current work acceptable.

Test setup was improved: `tests/conftest.py` now supports invoice creation and provides a rollback-oriented `db_session` fixture, plus an `organization_factory` fixture replacing repeated direct organization inserts. All 46 invoice tests passed after the session fixture change. About 27 direct invoice creation sites remain, mainly in invoice, payment, and report tests, and could be cleaned up later.

Ongoing architectural follow-ups include metered-usage aggregation, the staging-index threshold of four, queue/retry/backoff/scheduling/reconciliation/numbering concerns, ledger-semantics cleanup, and object-storage PDFs. Scheduled billing should stay on cron for now. Payment retry behavior, including exponential backoff, must remain unchanged.

3. Deploy dual-write service: `install -m 0644 /opt/cache-dualwrite/dualwrite-2.4.0.service /etc/systemd/system/cache-dualwrite.service && systemctl restart cache-dualwrite`
4. Backfill target cache: `python3 /opt/cache-migrate/backfill.py --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --target redis-new.internal:6379 --workers 16 --resume /var/lib/cache-migrate/cursor.json`
5. Reconcile source and target: `python3 /opt/cache-migrate/reconcile.py --source redis-cache.internal:6379 --target redis-new.internal:6379 --sample 100000`
6. Pause source writes: `redis-cli -h redis-cache.internal -p 6379 CLIENT PAUSE 30000 WRITE`
7. Switch application to target: `sed -i 's/^REDIS_PRIMARY=.*/REDIS_PRIMARY=redis-new.internal:6379/' /etc/cache-api.env && systemctl restart cache-api`
8. Run cutover smoke test: `curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/cache/health | jq -e '.redis.primary == "redis-new.internal:6379" and .status == "ok"'`
9. Disable old write path: `systemctl disable --now cache-dualwrite.service` (turn 110)
